paragraphs.text: Just a little bit of context: I had no WiFi all day because my ISP decided not to provide internet service from the hours of 10am to 1am. So, naturally, with no internet or TV, I resorted to my growing film downloads collection. Luckily, all of my music is physical now and I’ve been reducing my reliance on the cloud and keeping everything local which turned out to be a godsend. I had the choice to either watch Leviticus for (literally) the fifth time, or watch Mars Attacks! which I downloaded but never got around to watching.

I was pleasantly surprised by this film.
The story was charming, funny, and slightly emotional, and the visual effects were cute. I really loved what I think was the use of miniatures and practical effects for a lot of the big demolition scenes, which is always a really nice touch.

It was an absolutely brilliant cast. I can’t believe I hadn’t heard about this film until Mars Attracts came out, because it’s absolutely ram-packed with brilliant actors. I barely recognised Jack Black too he’s so young in this film!
It was funny, full of action, and had a well-paced, enjoyable story.
Overall, I’d give this a solid 3.5/5. I was really pleasantly surprised as I expected to be laughing at it rather than with it.
